CreativeLens | Founding Growth & Sales Lead | Remote (US) | Full-time

CreativeLens (creativelens.ai) helps companies that produce marketing content review it before it goes live — checking brand compliance, legal/compliance risk, performance concerns, and consistency across channels. We integrate with Figma, Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, Slack, and more.

We're hiring our first growth and sales lead to run outbound to in-house marketing leaders and turn early beta traction into a repeatable pipeline. This is a hands-on role: prospecting, outreach, demos, and closing early customers.

Compensation: base salary + commission + equity. We offer an optional 2-week paid trial so both sides can evaluate fit.

Remote — US-based only.

To apply, email careers@creativelens.ai.
